title: How often, habits, after and before

sections.content: You know this from Unit 17. Five frequency words stand right before the verb and never change: *mindig* (always), *gyakran* (often), *általában* (usually), *néha* (sometimes), *ritkán* (rarely). A time word can come first: *Reggel mindig olvasok.* For habits use *szokott* + infinitive. Only *szokott* takes the person ending; the infinitive is the stem + *-ni* and never changes. *Soha nem* means “never”, with *nem* right before the verb: *Soha nem főzök.*

sections.title: Asking, too, after
sections.content: Ask *Milyen gyakran?* and answer with a frequency word or with *minden* + a time word: *minden szombaton*. *Is* (“too”) goes right after the word it adds to: *Anna is tanul.* *Után* (“after”) and *előtt* (“before”) follow the noun: *ebéd után, munka előtt.*

items.english: In the morning I usually read.

sections.content: Put the person on *szokott*, not on the infinitive: *szoktam olvasni*. And never drop *nem* after *soha*: *Soha nem főzök*, not *Soha főzök*.
